environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as non-root user (uid 1000) on a standard containerd runtime with default seccomp profile. The container filesystem at /var/app/data contains user-uploaded content. An attacker who previously uploaded a symlink file pointing to /etc/shadow (via a separate upload endpoint that preserves symlinks from tar archives) can now read arbitrary host-mapped files through the WebSocket interface. No MAC policy is enforced; the container uses the default 'unconfined' AppArmor profile.

config.network: ClusterIP service, no ingress filtering on WebSocket
